analysis:
Test-only units examined. FeatureWaitlistTests.swift (new, head 1-721) exercises a new `darkbloom waitlist` CLI and a waitlist gate in SandboxSetupFlow (TB-013/T-061 surface, A-008 token use).

Token-scope tests: FeatureWaitlistClient.base accepts https or loopback http only and refuses http remote, ftp and query URLs (lines 187-196). The bearer token is sent only on waitlist requests, and the no-token case sends none (lines 217, 446-457).

Terminal-injection tests: coordinator text (title, summary, start_command) is printed with control, format and line-separator characters replaced, and --json output is escaped (lines 298-364).

Gate tests: a waitlisted, revoked, refused or unreachable answer stops setup before the Mac is checked or anything is downloaded (lines 575-604, 665-701).

Gate fails open on 404: a coordinator answering 404 for the sandbox waitlist lets setup continue (lines 555-573, 'going on'). So the gate is a UX/admission hint, not a security control. Downloading and running install.sh still depends on the existing TB-013 controls. Integration should confirm this.

Start-command display: start_command text from the coordinator is shown verbatim as a suggested command (line 247). It is displayed only, not executed, so I found no execution path in this evidence. Integration should confirm the implementation never runs start_command.

SandboxSetupTests.swift changes only add `waitlist: .approved` to existing test invocations (patch hunks @@536-1097).

Coverage limit: the implementation sources for FeatureWaitlistClient, FeatureWaitlistView and the SandboxSetupFlow gate are not in this batch. The integration pass must verify that their behavior matches the tests: token sent only to an https or loopback base; base derived from the configured coordinator; sanitization; and no execution of start_command. It should also check whether the threat model (TB-013/A-008) needs a note about the new authenticated waitlist endpoint and the advisory, fail-open gate. No regression is evidenced by these test files.
